sentences.en: The ship was carrying a lot of passengers on board.
The fisherman saved himself by means of a floating board.
sentences.zh: 渔民借助一块浮板救了自己。

sentences.en: There were quite a few passengers on board the ship.

senses.zh: 板, 牌子, 黑板 - 纸板, 木板 - 委员会, 董事会 - (包饭的)伙食 -
用木板覆盖或封闭 - 上(船、车或飞机) -
搭伙(并寄宿), 收费供膳食(及住宿)
